# TerraFirmaCraft Texture Templates

Some block atlas tiles are copied or recolored from TerraFirmaCraft texture templates:
https://github.com/TerraFirmaCraft/TerraFirmaCraft/tree/1.21.x/resources/texture_templates

License: EUPL-1.2. A copy of the license is stored at:
`templates/LICENSE.txt`

Modified in RUMPEL on 2026-05-14:
- scaled selected 16x16 templates to 64x64 atlas tiles;
- recolored several rock templates for RUMPEL ore, terracotta, clay, mud, obsidian,
  sculk, reinforced deepslate, amethyst, and dripstone tiles;
- kept existing RUMPEL dirt, grass, grass-side, stone, wood, leaves, grass-bush,
  and leaf-cluster textures unchanged.
